items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Dell Bright was the saxophone player... I stayed there about -- oh, six months or nine months... he went to work with Horace Henderson... So I took the band over there

ctx.x: Lux and T. Johnson, teamed them up, [Delbert] and a boy by the name of Dell Bright was the saxophone player.
